title: EquiMap: from SEM/EDS map tiles to phase maps, mineral identification and P-T estimates
description: EquiMap is an open Python toolkit that takes raw SEM/EDS map tiles to a pressure-temperature estimate. It stitches Bruker tiles, or imports Oxford AZtec exports, into a large-area EDS mosaic that keeps its spectra; calibrates the count maps against the instrument's own per-tile quantification; segments the mosaic into phase domains; suggests mineral names from a curated library; measures the length scale over which a bulk composition is representative; and inverts the observed assemblage and its modal proportions for P-T through pluggable thermodynamic backends (MAGEMin, Perple_X, pycalphad). The repository also holds the scripts and staged data that regenerate the figures of the accompanying methods paper (folder paper/figures).
